svg.text: DNS is the last mile — and it fails as a 403, not a timeout

text.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Your resolvers need a conditional forwarder into Azure, and the zone privatelink.azurewebsites.net holds the two A records —

text.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: one for the app, one for its scm name. A client without private resolution reaches the public address instead, which now answers 403.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A private endpoint and public access coexist on an App Service by default: the endpoint is the route in, and publicNetworkAccess = Disabled is

text.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: what removes the other one. Nothing here is enforced by a rule — this shape is enforced by there being no public endpoint to reach.
